title: Canonicalizing Path Sandboxer
prompt: Implement `sandboxPath`: split on '/', process segments against a stack, then require the canonical result to be under "/data". The battery includes escapes that contain no literal ".." pattern naively banned, and stays-legal paths that contain ".." legitimately.

tests.name: traversal battery
tests.hint: Stack of segments; start with {"data"}. '..' pops (if non-empty; popping the root guard => escape => nullopt); '.' and '' skipped; other segments push. Rebuild as '/data/...' and that IS the check.
